description: The agentic AI moment has arrived, but delivering on its promise requires more than good models. author: Pahal Patangia
description: Financial institutions have spent years building AI: fraud models, credit models, recommendation engines and risk systems. title: Why Financial Institutions Are Converging on Transaction Foundation Models to Build Their Own Intelligence
